name: Issue Pipeline (Solo)
description: The full issue-pipeline in one project: a coordinator plus nine custom subagents (analyst, planner, implementer, security, scalability, dry, done-gate, retrospective) that reproduce, analyse into 5 options, plan, implement, review, gate, and ship a PR — with the same in-the-wild prompt-evolution loop as the multi-project system. Good for small teams, or as the seed a bigger system later splits from (see templates/issue-pipeline/).
